title: Scaffold Document
description: A single document produced by the implementation_scaffold phase (e.g. an implementation plan, scaffold index, or proposed source diff). Scaffold documents record planning and proposed-change artifacts without modifying source files. One scaffold-document artifact is registered per file written to pipeline_mcp_data/scaffold/.

filename.description: File name of the scaffold document (e.g. 'IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md')

document_type.description: Category of the scaffold document. 'plan' = implementation plan, 'index' = running index across scaffold runs, 'proposed-diff' = proposed markdown/source patch, 'other' = any other scaffold output.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the document was generated

byte_size.description: Size of the document in bytes. Nullable because some scaffold writers do not record size at generation time.

description.description: Human-readable description of the document's purpose and contents

status.description: Free-form status string (e.g. 'proposed — not yet applied', 'complete', 'mixed — Part 1 APPLIED; Parts 2-5 PROPOSED')
